provenance.recording_source: ros2-crazyflie-mocap repository, commit 97978073c95b657b55cedc4cd00e7ed1984dbe32, root CSV files
provenance.bridge_commit_message: adding logging, filmed and logged dyn obst and constr star on 20260522
provenance.star_bound_derivation: shift = AMP_X * STAR_INNER_RATIO * cos(atan2(AMP_X, AMP_Y)); lower = XY_MIN - shift; upper = XY_MAX - shift; AMP_X=AMP_Y=2 m, STAR_INNER_RATIO=0.25, XY_MIN=-1 m, XY_MAX=1 m.
star_association_evidence: The author identifies b82e18d as the filmed constrained-star source (docs/reproducibility/configurations.md).
The May 25 bridge commit identifies May 22 as the filmed/logged dynamic-obstacle and constrained-star session.
The selected 18:52:11 and 18:53:42 logs contain one start and one reset each, stable altitude, repeated motion near a 25 s period, and similar paths after subtracting each logged target origin.
They were selected for explicit command intervals and stable altitude, not for lowest constraint violation. Other late-May logs remain in the original source repository.

Exact flashed firmware/bitstream association and association with the paper video are not established. The local star lateral-video metadata gives 2026-05-22T23:00:44Z, which alone does not match a selected log.

A saved 1khzConstrStar.bit has embedded build date/time 2026/05/22 14:18:07, but no log-to-bitstream identifier. The later server exp checkout has H23/tick-div10; its current headers are not treated as the flight configuration.
provenance.dynamic_coordinate_evidence: Bridge code applies identical axis/sign mapping to drone and box x. TAKE1 box*_cf_x equals box*_raw_x; floating bounds are inset by 0.20 m from box markers. This does not establish distance to obstacle surfaces.
provenance.timestamp_convention: elapsed_s and the misleadingly named monotonic_s are produced from time.time(); mocap_stamp_s is the latest ROS pose header time. State estimates and obstacle poses are cached asynchronously. No controller receive/apply timestamp is recorded.
provenance.zero_bound_word: In ADMM.cpp a packed zero bound word requests generated static defaults. Dynamic-log samples after a (0,0) transmission are not compared to x=0; static defaults are not source-matched for these runs and those samples are explicitly counted as unavailable.
provenance.dynamic_selection: TAKE1 is the author-selected dynamic-obstacle demonstration and supplies the paper obstacle panels. Metrics describe this single recording, not a multi-trial aggregate.

interval.description: Complete recording, including any termination/handling; no independently identified flight-only interval.

experiments.bounds_description: Last transmitted signed integer x bounds / 1000, held in recorded event order; world coordinates.
experiments.tracking_unavailable_reason: Matching onboard reference table and verified playback timing are not bundled.
notes: constraint_active means bridge transmission enabled, not acknowledged application.
Cached drone and obstacle samples are not guaranteed simultaneous; plotted floating bounds are diagnostic only.
A transmitted (0,0) pair requests compiled static defaults; those samples are excluded from dynamic-bound metrics and counted, not treated as x=0.

experiments.attribution: Inferred match to constrained-star source b82e18d; bounds and origin conditional on that match

interval.description: All valid samples from the unique start_traj command through reset_traj, inclusive.

experiments.bounds_description: Static XY box from b82e18d defaults, [-1.3535533905932737, 0.6464466094067263] m relative to logged target origin (inferred).
experiments.tracking_unavailable_reason: Reference geometry reconstructed from b82e18d; exact flight table, command latency and playback phase are unverified.
notes: constraint_active=0 disables dynamic-bound transmission; it does not disable the FPGA static box.
Source defaults H27/k9 and a 20-call reference divider at 1 kHz imply 20 ms playback samples, a 0.56 s entry prefix and a 25 s loop; exact flight timing remains unverified.
This is a conditional source-bound analysis, not confirmation of the exact paper-video take.

reference.description: One 25 s geometric cycle at 20 ms spacing, before the source H+1=28 sample entry prefix. Used for XY overlay only.
